It has a pleasantly mild scent and the stuff actually worked, even through a tough workout. It does have a sticky feel at first but that goes away quickly. However, after the third day I noticed a very sensitive red rash appearing under my arms. I'll spare you the photos but it looks and feels like a bad sunburn. reviews.t: ... the first natural deodorants that I’ve purchased and feel like it actually works
reviews.x: One of the first natural deodorants that I’ve purchased and feel like it actually works!!! I’m a gym rat so it’s important to me to smell fresh and not worried about odor while working out, truly satisfied with my purchase
If you have sensitive skin I would not recommend you purchase this product.  I used this deodorant twice, both times it had my underarms on fire.  It's not long lasting at all.

At first this was the holy Grail of deodorant for me. For weeks I was amazed at how well it worked, I never had any bad odors for the entire day and the smell was really nice. But after about 4 weeks I had a very painful chaffing rash. I tried to push through it but it got so bad I couldn't even sleep at night from the irritations. I went clean from this deodorant for a few weeks until it cleared. I tried once more to make it work because I loved this product so much. Just like the first time th

I have sensitive skin and have not had the problems that others have described. Perhaps there is an ingredient they are allergic to, or perhaps it’s becaise I alternate this deodorant with antiperspirant a few days a week. The reason I alternate is because 7 days a week of antiperspirant gives me a rash. I am also sensitive to scents and this has a very pleasant smell. Lastly and most important, it WORKS. I sweat, or, if you go with what my grandmother says “I glow”, yeah, but I “glow” like a ho

This deodorant certainly does NOT last 24 hours. I feel like I had to reapply it every two hours. This crap was $8 damn dollars! I would expect something at that price to at least keep me smelling good for my 9 hour work day.

Besides Milk of Magnesia deodorants (which give me a bad rash) this is the best non-antiperspirant I've ever used.  The only problem is an occasional slight rash around the armpits (not directly in), but a dab of rash cream on clean skin clears it up.  Not even sure it's the deodorant that's causing the rash.  The aroma is more copra than coconut cream, and it's not a strong scent.  Wore it today in 87 degree heat - no odor for 8 hours.

In the process of switching to a natural deodorant it was hard to find one that actually worked. Love this deodorant as it works and last all day. I use to use clinical strength deodorant with 18% aluminum content. So glad I discovered this deodorant and it’s strong enough to replace the clinical strength... my husband and I both use the same deodorant and it works equally as great for both of us. The smell is gender neutral

reviews.t: Not long lasting, not for sensitive skin.
reviews.x: I loved the scent of this natural deodorant, But my BO started smelling like onions and I started getting a rash. It’s nice for like an hour, and then my BO takes over. If you have a strong smell/sensitive skin, this is not for you. But, if you don’t have these issues, it’s an amazing scent that I love.

Smells really good. Feels soft and smooth. This item also does not contain aluminum.  This PERSONALLY does not irritate my armpit causing me to break out in a rash nor does it cause the lymph nodes in my arm pits to swell. I am pretty happy I found this product.

reviews.t: Looking for a natural deodarant? This is not it
reviews.x: This unfortunately doesn't work. It's super messy and turns kind of foamy/white when applied.. I have to rub it in with my fingers because it looks gross.  I smell very shortly after applying 1-2 hours,  no where near 24 hour protection as on the container states . Does not do the job. It smells good and I really was hoping for this to work. Anyone looking for a good natural deodorant this is not it.. Try native. Native brand works so good keeps me dry and odorless.

I’ve tried all kinds of natural deodorants and this one is by far my favorite! Some have given me rashes from baking soda, others do not sustain over long periods of time & this one is gentle, lasts & smells great! You still sweat which is natural but you don’t deal with harsh chemicals and even for the most sensitive skin, it doesn’t create any kind f irritation.  I always have at least 2 on hand and share it for others who want to try it and they all fall in love!

This is the 1st natural deodorant Ive tried & I love it. The feel of it is quite different than regular antiperspirants. Like its not as hard or solid. I actually ended up keeping mine in a mini fridge. Other than that it works great. Got it for my daughter & I. Neither of us are musty so its a win!

This is the greatest natural deodorant ever. Hands down. And I’ve tried them all. It smells amazing, lasts forever and won’t give you cancer. Also love the fact that I’m supporting a brand that was started in Harlem NYC. Bonus!

reviews.t: What you put on your body must be pure
reviews.x: no chemicals here!  It smells pure and works well.  Look no further!
It does not smell like the one I purchased at GNC.

I have tried a few different natural deos (Native and Lume), but this is the best one for me. A couple things - I bought mine at Walmart several years ago and am coming here for more because I can no longer find it there, so I’m praying the recipe is the same! I generally don’t have odor problems, I went probably 15-20 years not actually wearing any because I just didn’t have reason to. But, I do have sweating problems, and those have increased as I’ve aged. (43 now). I know sweat is natural and

So, I was excited to try this deodorant because it was suppose to be natural . The packaging was fine. Scent was beautiful ! I have the coconut and papaya, but it does not last at all! You put some on, It instantly turns white and messy. Within two hours I was sweating and smelled as if I didn’t put deodorant on. Good thing I had my wipes and dove ! Disappointed

I love the smell; I love how effective it is; I love that the container lasts a long time. I put deodorant on everyday, twice a day & it still lasts practically a whole year. I literally have to hide them from my daughter, because she is always taking my extras; I like to have multiples for travel & she grabs my spares.  It really is a 5 star product.

Bought for myself and daughters (age 11 & 16). Day 1 we all said we liked it but as of day 2 we realized by the end of the day it was doing its job. Normally I no issue with odor but by the end of the day I did not feel secure and especially because right now we are all home so very minimal activity. Was so hoping to love it like most of the reviews

I read the ingredients…. But there is something in there that kept making me break out. I have previously bought this combo of deodorant before… may be the starch. Anyway, smells amazing but unfortunately did not work for me… AND my arms were still stinky after a few hours… And NO I do not perspire easy.

Finally transitioned to eco-friendly deodorant that smells amazing.  I have sensitive skin and did not get a rash from using it.  Only minor issue is that for me, it only lasts for about 8-9 hours depending on my activity level. I tend to reapply after work if I go to workout or something else.

I absolutely hated this deodorant and I had high hopes. It was very sticky after application. It first went on very wet and slick- so I thought it would dry nicely but it didn’t. It dried in a sticky and uncomfortable manner. NOT cool. I tried it twice and then threw them both away.

I don’t know if they have changed the formula but I had a very uncomfortable allergic reaction. I am someone that never gets allergic reactions to almost everything but today I know. I’m wondering why all of a sudden I am experiencing this since I’ve used this product since 2019.

Almost no scent to the coconut papaya. And immediately upon application, my armpits were burning! I do not have sensitive skin. I have tried Many MANY natural deodorants in trying to find one that actually works, and I have never had a skin reaction.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well and keeps them fresh, even through workouts and long days.
Several reviewers report skin irritation, rashes, or burning, especially those with sensitive skin.
Some reviewers say it does not last long and they smell shortly after applying.
Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant scent.
A few reviewers mention a sticky, messy, or unusual texture.
